universe_scope: user-supplied ticker list; point-in-time membership is only as valid as the supplied universe file

filters.atr_method: Wilder ATR(14): first 14 true ranges seeded by arithmetic mean, then recursive Wilder smoothing
filters.relative_volume_formula: current 09:30 5-minute bar volume / arithmetic mean of prior 14 09:30 5-minute bar volumes
filters.ranking: relative_volume descending, then ticker ascending; one combined long/short ranking
filters.doji_handling: rank after numeric filters; if selected, mark DOJI_SKIP and do not provide an entry reference

execution_status: read_only_deterministic_screen_only; no orders or positions created or modified
limitations: The universe is only as complete as the supplied point-in-time S&P 500 file; it is not the full U.S.-listed market.
Missing daily sessions or opening bars are rejected; no bars or volumes are imputed.
Historical halted-security status is not verified by this screener and is not inferred from missing bars.
ETFs are not identified or excluded by this screener; supplied universe membership controls scope.
IEX and SIP are separate feed-specific variants. This run enforces one feed across daily and intraday inputs.
The output contains screen candidates and price reference levels only; it does not submit orders or simulate fills.
